text.tspan: Inputs, outputs, and insertion points of LoRA, ExemplarPromptAdapter, RSS-DA, MedicalImageAdapter, BoundaryAwareAdapter, and refine_head
Base path, optional wrapper adapters, and independent retrieval/prompt branches are separated by colored regions.
visual prompt includes positive, boundary, and negative prototype tokens
output: image_embeddings for SAM3 decoder and MedEx wrapper
LoRA is inside frozen SAM3; wrapper refine_head remains trainable
in: query/image features out: memory/logit bias maps
(E) MedEx Wrapper Refinement after SAM3 Forward
Key route: Image/Prompt inputs -> SAM3 encoder/decoder -> conditioned mask_logits -> MedEx wrapper refinement -> final mask.
